name: evidence-gate
means: A proposed relation is stored only when it is signed, both its anchors resolve, its predicate is in the vocabulary, neither end is a concept marked drifted, it duplicates no stored relation and its evidence is a quote that appears, whitespace-normalized, in one anchor's text — never a paraphrase; each rejected proposal stays in the proposals file with why.
